- Data residency & audit logs are must-haves for the initial pilot.
- Primary success metrics: 99.9% inference availability during business hours, under 150ms p95 for interactive calls.

Proposed next step: a 60–75 minute alignment session that includes Ops (runbook/monitoring), Security (data flows & SOC artifacts), and Engineering (integration & performance). Goal: agree mutual action plan, identify pre-reqs for a short pilot, and lock resources.

Three slots I can offer next week (PDT):
- Tue Jul 3 • 10:00–11:15 AM

- Thu Jul 5 • 8:30–9:45 AM

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben (platform performance) and Karthik (solutions lead) once we confirm a time.
